title: Pastel Nursery Wall Art Set of 3, Moon Bunny, Rainbow Sun, Little Cloud, Gender Neutral Printable Nursery Prints, Digital Download
description:
Three gentle prints for a calm nursery: a bunny napping on the moon, a sleepy sun over a rainbow, and a little cloud with tiny charms.

What you get: each print in 5 ratios at 300 dpi, so you can print up to:
- 4x5 (8x10, 16x20 in)
- 3x4 (12x16, 15x20 in)
- 2x3 (4x6 up to 16x24 in)
- 11x14 in
- ISO A sizes (A5 to A2)

This is a digital download. No physical item is shipped. Print at home, at a local print shop or online. Colours vary a little by screen and printer. For personal use only; please don't resell or share the files.

About the art: designed by Littlefold, a Steadfold studio. The illustrations were drawn with the help of AI (AI-written vector code), then chosen, coloured and finished by us.
